input: Find arts, crafts, music, theater and dance summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Brevard, Pisgah Forest, Rosman, Cedar Mountain, Lake Toxaway and Sapphire, NC (Transylvania County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Brevard summer camp 2026 art music theater dance kids

candidates.name: Transylvania Community Arts Council
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Arts Academy offered weeklong sessions for ages 6–17 in pottery, painting, photography, dance and video game design.

candidates.name: Brevard Art Classes
candidates.note: 2026 children's summer art camps offered hands-on artmaking with three themes across two weeks.

candidates.name: Carolina Creative Arts
candidates.note: Youth creative-arts summer camp; official page documents its 2025 camp production.

candidates.name: Carolina Dance Collective
candidates.note: Summer dance camps grouped by grade, covering ballet, tap, jazz, modern, musical theatre and improvisation.

candidates.name: Brevard Music Center
candidates.note: Residential summer music institute includes teenage musicians ages 14 and older, with instrumental and jazz programs.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: 2025 Choral Institute for high-school singers; also ran 2026 Campus Adventures for rising grades 1–7.

candidates.name: Mountain Roots
candidates.note: Preschool and elementary day camps combine outdoor learning with art and music; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Transylvania County Library
candidates.note: 2026 summer reading programming included a June 10 kickoff with crafts and games for children and teens.

candidates.name: Eagle's Nest Foundation
candidates.note: Coed Eagle's Nest Camp includes art, drama, music and songwriting alongside outdoor activities; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Coed overnight nature camp for grades 1–12 includes pottery, music and theater; 2027 enrollment open.

candidates.name: Camp Merrie-Woode
candidates.note: Girls' residential camp includes ceramics, stained glass, weaving, woodworking, music, drama and dance.

candidates.name: Rockbrook Camp for Girls
candidates.note: Girls ages 6–16 attend sleepaway sessions with ceramics, crafts, horseback riding and outdoor adventure.

candidates.name: Keystone Camp
candidates.note: Girls' residential summer camp offers arts and drama alongside riding, climbing and sports.

candidates.name: Camp Illahee
candidates.note: Christian girls' camp for grades 2–11 includes arts and crafts, drama and dance.

candidates.name: Gwynn Valley Camp
candidates.note: Coed day and overnight camp combines arts and theater with farm, wilderness and traditional camp activities; 2027 registration open.

candidates.name: Camp Carolina
candidates.note: Boys' sleepaway camp for grades K–11 includes arts and crafts; official site lists 2026 summer sessions.

candidates.name: Camp High Rocks
candidates.note: Boys' overnight camp includes arts and crafts with outdoor activities; one- to four-week 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: KE Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Toxaway at Lake Toxaway Country Club; traditional day-camp activities include crafts, games and swimming.
